title: Heuristic evaluation and staged upgrade orchestration for multilingual cross-encoder rerankers
creator: Ava Patel
description: We need a repeatable, low-risk process to evaluate and roll out new cross-encoder reranker variants across locales. This ticket covers building the offline heuristic evaluator, the staged canary orchestration, and automated regression checks (quality + latency) for multilingual models including quantized fallbacks.
background: Recent offline experiments show several cross-encoder variants (base FP16, int8 quantized, and locale-specialized adapters) produce gains in MRR on English but have mixed behaviour on high-morphology languages. On prod, reranking latency P95 has tight SLOs and we must avoid regressions that impact user experience or cost. We also need a fast rollback path and telemetry to detect regressions post-rollout.
proposal: 1) Implement a heuristic evaluation harness that runs candidate models across stratified locale+query buckets using held-out prompt sets and real-traffic shadowing. 2) Create a staged canary controller that progressively shifts traffic with quality and latency gates. 3) Add regression suites (offline eval + smoke online checks) and dashboarding for per-locale metrics. 4) Support quantized variants and KV warmstart simulation in the harness to predict latency/throughput.
decision_log: 2026-02-20: Decided to keep experiments deterministic by using fixed seed sampling and a canonical prompt set per locale. 2026-02-24: Chose to include int8 quantized artifacts for throughput testing but require FP16 for initial canary unless latency gate permits. 2026-02-28: Agreed on gating thresholds in acceptance criteria below.
tasks: T1: Build offline evaluator that runs candidates on stratified buckets (by locale, token length, query type)
T2: Integrate shadow-traffic runner to collect candidate outputs without affecting users
T3: Implement canary controller with rollout steps (1%, 5%, 20%, 50%) and automatic rollback
T4: Create regression smoke suite that runs after each rollout step (quality + perf checks)
T5: Instrument per-model per-locale metrics in Console (MRR, NDCG, P95 latency, error-rate)
T6: Add support for simulated KV-cache warmstart measurement in harness
T7: Validate int8 quantized variant latency with representative hardware in CI
T8: Run cross-locale calibration experiments to detect score scale mismatches and implement a lightweight recalibration layer
T9: Produce rollout runbook and rollback checklist and link to PRs/Dashboards
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Offline evaluator can produce per-locale MRR and NDCG with confidence intervals and compare baseline vs candidate
AC2: Candidate passes quality gate: absolute MRR delta >= +0.012 for high-traffic locales OR no drop > 0.005 for any locale (safety threshold)
AC3: Latency gate: additional P95 overhead introduced by candidate <= 12ms on average for target hardware and per-replica throughput >= 150 QPS
AC4: Canary controller automatically rolls forward through 1%, 5%, 20%, 50% steps with automated checks at each step and can rollback within 5 minutes of gate failure
AC5: Quantized variant only allowed to serve if simulated warmstart latency within 1.2x FP16 baseline and quality within thresholds
AC6: New metrics available in Console per-route and per-model for at least 30 days, and an alert fired if per-locale NDCG drops by >1%
AC7: Runbook exists with exact commands, play-by-play monitoring links (dashboards/PRs), and owner contact info
implementation_notes: Start with offline harness and shadow traffic to reduce blast radius. Use canary controller that talks to routing layer to pin traffic to model variants. Prefer read-only feature flags until metrics are reliable. Keep a fast fallback path to baseline model and ensure API compatibility with structured outputs.
